name: Math-Verify
author: huggingface
one_liner: Rule-based checker that parses an LLM's math answer and tests it against the gold answer, usable as a reward.

loop.proposes: nothing; it checks answers a model has already written
loop.judged_by: parsing and symbolic comparison of the model answer against the gold answer, in code
loop.steers: its pass/fail result can serve as the reward when training a model, as the README recommends for reward verification

not_proved: It checks that a final answer matches the reference, not that the reasoning is sound, and unusual answer formats can be missed or mismatched.
